svg.title: Five things that have to be true for a new feature, placed by how much it depends on each and how much you know.
svg.desc: A grocery app wants to let people order from two stores in one delivery. Five things have to be true, each a dot on a square map. Up the side, how much the idea depends on it; along the bottom, how little you know about it. That shoppers can collect from two stores and stay on time, and that the app can show both stores' shelves, matter a lot, but there's evidence for both. That people find the option at checkout is known and matters less. That people will pay a second fee is a guess that matters less. That people want two stores in one order at all is both: the idea depends on it, and it's a guess. It sits alone in the top right corner, marked to test first.
